sql: SELECT r.year,MAX(r.round) calendar_last,MAX(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM results re WHERE re.race_id=r.race_id) THEN r.round END) results_last,MAX(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM driver_standings d WHERE d.race_id=r.race_id) THEN r.round END) standings_last,COUNT(*) races FROM races r WHERE year>=2001 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
